name: YDT
fix_description: In proxyTransfer, the access check validates the callerModule parameter (user-controlled input) instead of msg.sender. Any attacker can pass a whitelisted module address as the parameter while calling directly. Fix: replace callerModule check with require(msg.sender == address(taxModule) || msg.sender == address(referralModule) || ...).
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is very short and effectively a direct abuse of a likely missing access control/unsafe external-call path: it invokes a token function by selector, triggers the pair, then swaps the drained tokens for USDT. It is a simple 2-3 step exploit with minimal protocol-specific logic, no flash loan, and only basic DEX swap knowledge required.
